objective: Use settled strip and side-panel geometry for unit-frame joins and avoid unrelated target chrome rebuilds on held-action crossings.
changes: Defer the unit screen anchor callbacks inside a drag layout transaction. Apply player and target screen anchors once between envelope completion and junction commit.
Reuse public screen anchors when the native point matches. Keep the complete target chrome refresh for ordinary calls and placement changes.
Use the original placement writer if the point is altered, unavailable or restricted. Retain existing combat guards and downstream phase ordering.

replay.scope: Actual Lua drag, strip, dependent notification and unit position entry points. Native frames, target child paint and envelope behavior modeled. No native frame-time or pixel comparison.
replay.changedEnvelope: Updated support is read after envelope completion. Both unit roots move once in the model. The archived transaction reaches the modeled junction commit with the prior height.
guards: changed placement preserves all target callbacks
ordinary call still fully refreshes target
private, denied, missing, extra and externally changed points use original writer
